title: order-spec
description: A work order as the specify stage writes it: owned paths and acceptance criteria that are commands.

order_id.description: The order id, as tac work uses it.

team.description: The team that owns the order.

owns.description: Every path or glob the order may change, and nothing else.

id.description: A short criterion id, unique in the order.

text.description: What must hold, in plain words.

check.description: The command that proves it, run by just work-check.

criteria.description: The acceptance criteria; every one is a command.

cross_team.description: Teams whose paths the order touches and whose sign-off it needs; empty when none.

skills.description: Skill names the builder loads for this order.

notes.description: Anything the builder must know that fits nowhere else; null when nothing.
